planning_decision: Recent completed work: Nincada, Empoleon, Slaking. Use lingerie rather than their adult-roleplay categories, museum page conservation rather than their standing laboratory scene/pottery/plant care, and walking in rain rather than shopping or kaftan stroll. All direction/frame pairs differ; side and turning-midmotion are new values. Source multiset strong/strong/subtle differs from all three.
faceComparison: Compared actual Nincada/Empoleon/Slaking anchors: Shedinja has relaxed downturned eyes, delicate small nose and thin restrained lips in a soft medium-width face; Nincada has a narrower chin and more angular eye corners, Empoleon has a long narrow lower face and long nose, Slaking has broader cheeks and fuller lips.
finalFacePrompt: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly rounded face, balanced length, medium width; soft rounded jaw; drooping eyes, medium size, downturned outer corners, average spacing; straight medium brows; small delicate nose; thin lips.
